2488086.title: Daejeon Seo-gu Art Festival
2488086.overview: Daejeon’s big autumn arts festival, in its 10th edition from 9 to 11 October 2026 in Saemmeori and Boramae parks in front of the Seo-gu District Office, under the theme ‘chill with Seo-gu art’. An art market brings artists from across Korea to show and sell their work, alongside outdoor sculpture, special exhibitions, art activities for families and concerts into the evening. Free.
2488086.place: Saemmeori and Boramae Parks, Seo-gu, Daejeon

4117047.title: Yangpyeong Chive Festival
4117047.overview: A village festival run by farmers and residents at Yangdong Station in Yangpyeong, Korea’s top-growing area for buchu, Korean garlic chives, in its 7th year. Eat chive rice soup, chive rice cakes, chive noodles and chive makgeolli, buy fresh local produce, and try planting and trimming chives, with games for children. An easy family day out on the Gyeongui–Jungang Line. Free.
4117047.sponsor: Yangdong-myeon and the Yangpyeong Chive Festival Committee

2559193.title: Icheon Ginseng Health Festival
2559193.overview: Icheon is one of Korea’s largest ginseng-growing areas, and its harvest festival is the place to buy this year’s fresh ginseng straight from growers at market prices. There is a ginseng judging contest, ginseng kimchi-making, a ginseng foot bath, a ginseng auction and stage concerts, and fried ginseng and ginseng makgeolli to eat. Free.
2559193.place: Icheon Ginseng Sales Center, East Seoul–Gyeonggi Ginseng Cooperative

2560824.title: Jeju Flatfish Festival
2560824.overview: Korea’s only festival devoted to gwangeo, the olive flounder farmed off Jeju, held every October since 2016. Local fish farmers sell flounder sashimi, sushi, fish cakes, tteokbokki and pancakes at low prices, and there are hands-on events such as catching flounder by hand, a singing contest, a youth dance competition and a children’s drawing contest. Free entry.
2560824.place: Jeju Fish Farming Cooperative, Jeju City

4117084.title: HELLO DDC Festival, Dongducheon
4117084.overview: A night festival in the Bosan-dong foreigners’ tourist zone of Dongducheon, the old US Army town north of Seoul, showing off its unusual mix of street culture, music and art. An open stage, a dance programme and a concert run into the evening, with craft workshops and a food zone. Free.
